research_question: Does adding only a condition-matched opposite-provider preference term improve provider-specific likelihood margins on four never-used sources relative to a compute-matched SFT control?
interpretation_limits: A pass shows only that the pairwise objective improves source-disjoint provider-conditioned likelihood margins after 16 updates.
It does not prove generation quality, target-person fidelity, persistent save/reload equivalence, or production readiness.
All preferred and rejected answers are synthetic source-independent curriculum data, not target-person utterances or benchmark items.
